description: React component for managing expenses, including listing, filtering, creating, editing, and deleting expense entries with modal forms and service integrations.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches categories and expenses based on current filters and updates state.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Applies current filters and refetches expense data.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares form for creating a new expense and opens modal.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares form with existing expense data for editing and opens modal.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating an expense, including receipt upload.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes an expense after user confirmation and updates the list.
